newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: HARMONY ACQUIRES CONS MODDER.
newsitem.headline: HARMONY ACQUIRES CONS MODDER.

text.p: Harmony Gold Mining Co Ltd has acquired the entire issued share capital of Consolidated Modderfontein Mines Ltd whose Johannesburg Stock Exchange listing has been terminated, the companies said on Monday.

The companies said that the record date for an earlier detailed scheme of arrangement was Friday June 27. The scheme became operative on Monday June 30 on which date Harmony became the owner of the entire issued share capital of Cons Modder.

The listing of Cons Modder shares was terminated on Friday June 27. The listing of Harmony shares to be issued in terms of teh scheme commenced on the JSE and the London Stock Exchange on Monday June 30.
